support_policy_note: The nominal distribution is conditional on measured Table-VI support. Zero probability outside support is a declared reference-model choice, not evidence that the physical cross section vanishes there. Alternate source-bound support/extrapolation models remain a required sensitivity under issue #1178.
uncertainty_note: Central values only. Statistical and systematic cross-section nuisance propagation remains issue #1179.
validation_note: Deterministic interval inverse and source-byte checks are repository-tested. A compiled Geant4 build, seeded generator-level closure, production run manifest serialization, and detector-response propagation remain required before authorising physical claims.
